tests.name: new measurement drains an old tick and clears previous records before collecting its own samples
measurement locks configuration, movement, step and camera entries including direct control callbacks
pause aborts a partial run only after all in-flight workers settle, with no late sample or false completion
a new completed run contains exactly 60 fresh accepted steps and restores all controls
explicit reset ends a live benchmark and drains its pending step before pose reset
native worker failure clears the active benchmark and preserves failure freeze/capture evidence
viewport resize aborts measurement before changing its recorded camera or canvas dimensions
paused single-step completion forces current HUD and evidence after all workers, including an existing tick without another solve

scope: actual main.mjs handlers and measurement lifecycle with deferred worker/DOM/renderer interfaces; no native solver timings, browser rendering or FPS claim
browserCheckRemaining: click Pause during a real measurement, confirm aborted record and restored input, then complete a new 60-step run
